note: axf-data as an axHub downstream (route only: axHub keeps the service token, never the data). axHub proxies POST /mcp to the url with the token as a bearer, the same way it proxies the console's /mcp, and lists the tools under the prefix. Its container joins the internal axf-data network (deploy/install-data.sh, AXF_DATA_CLIENTS). Data tokens: conf/env/axhub.env on the VPS (AXF_DATA_TOKEN); never in the repo.
name: Console data (axf-data)
stores: nothing: every call is forwarded; axf-data answers with the hub token's grants (notes, builds, settings, planner read/write; ui-review and changes read)
